source.notes: ICSE Class IX school second semester examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'II SEMESTER EXAMINATION, FEB. - 2025', 'Class - IX', 'Time: 2 hrs.', 'Sub: Biology', 'M.M.: 100'; examYear 2025 as printed. Footer prints '[ Continuous Assessment - 20 Marks ]'. This is a different file from the already-packed icse-class-9-2-sem-biology-280425-2025 (different paper and sha256). Section I (attempt all) prints 'Q.1 Multiple Choice Questions. 15' but no MCQ items appear in the file, so Q.1 has no entry. Q.2 parts A) and B) print only group totals (5 each) and are kept as single entries; parts C., D., E. have no printed marks (recorded as 0, LOW). Section II (attempt any four): only Q.5, Q.7 and Q.8 are numbered on the scan; the other three questions are numbered 3, 4 and 6 from the sequence and flagged. The first Section II question prints one total (10) for its parts a)-e) and is kept as one entry. Handwriting and strike-throughs on the scan were ignored. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Figures are not reproduced. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
